description.value: You gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, your Constitution score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When a Weaver feature (such as Bind, Pin Badge, or the Hunter's __Focus__) is interrupted as a result of taking damage, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, the damage you took does not interrupt any Weaver features.
Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10.

Whenever you hit a target with a Weapon and roll the max number on one of your weapon's damage dice, roll an additional die of that type and add it to the damage. The new die counts as one of your weapon's damage dice. This cannot happen more than a number of times equal to the ability modifier used to make the attack on a single attack.
You learn the basics of martial combat:

entries: **Weapon Proficiency**: You gain proficiency in two weapons
**Weapon Mastery**: Choose a class. Gain 2 Masteries from that class's mastery list. Whenever you gain a level you can swap one of these masteries with a different mastery from the same list.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

description.value: You learn a fighting style:

entries: **Fighting Style**: You gain a fighting style feat
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Sharpshooter
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Shrapnel**: When you make an attack with a ranged weapon against a creature that is behind cover and hit, deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
**Firing in Melee**: Being within reach of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged Attack Rolls with Weapons.
**Long Shots**: Attacking at Long Range doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged Attack Rolls with Weapons.

name: Heavy Armor Master
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Damage Reduction**: While you're wearing Heavy Armor, reduce any damage dealt to you by weapon attacks by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Jumper
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Movement Speed**: You gain movement equal to half your movement speed whenever you take an action other than the magic action or the attack action.
**Jumping**: Your max jump distance is doubled.

name: Mind Breaker
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

entries: **Shatter Mind**: If you force a creature to make a saving throw to maintain concentration by damaging them with a weapon attack and they fail by 5 or more, the attack becomes a crit. If it was already a crit, then the next time you force them to make a saving throw to maintain concentration within the next minute they have disadvantage.

**Guard Mind**: Before you make an intelligence, charisma or wisdom saving throw, you can choose to add your proficiency bonus to the roll. If you do and fail, you cannot use this again until you finish a long rest.

name: Mage Slayer
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

entries: **Break Concentration**: Once per turn before a creature would succeed or fail on a saving throw to maintain concentration that you caused them to make, you can subtract your proficiency bonus from their saving throw.

**Spellguard**: If someone you can touch would fail a saving throw against a spell, you can add twice your proficiency bonus potentially changing it into a success. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long or Short Rest.

name: Spell Sniper
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

entries: **Shrapnel**: When you hit a creature that is behind cover with a spell attack, deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
**Casting in Melee**: Being within reach of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your Attack Rolls with Spells.
**Increased Range**: When you cast a Spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and that requires you to make an Attack Roll, you can increase the Spell's range by 60 feet.

name: Athlete
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Climb Speed**: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed
**Hop Up**: When you are Prone, getting up only spends 5ft of movement
**Jumping**: Once at any time you can add 5 times your proficiency bonus to your jump distance until the start of your next turn. You regain this ability on a short or long rest.

name: Crossbow Expert
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Ignore Loading**: You ignore the Loading property.
**Firing in Melee**: Being within reach of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your Attack Rolls with crossbows, arbelests or hand crossbows.
**Recoil**: Whenever you make an attack with a crossbow, arbelests or hand crossbow you are pushed 5ft in the opposite direction of the attack.

name: Dual Flurry
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

entries: **Flurry**: You can attack twice, instead of once, as part of the light property.

name: Ancestral Mastery
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: **Borrowed Masteries**: Learn 3 masteries and choose a damage type for each. You can use these masteries on any weapon attack that makes an attack roll. When you do, for that attack you can change the weapon's damage type to the type that was chosen for that mastery and you gain tolerance to that damage type until the end of your next turn
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Skill Expert
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Proficiency**: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
**Expertise**: Gain expertise in a skill offered by the class that granted you this feat. If you were proficient in that skill, gain proficiency in a skill of your choice.

name: Weapon Master
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:

entries: **Proficiency**: You gain proficiency in three weapons.
**Weapon Mastery**: Choose a class. Gain 5 Masteries from that list. Whenever you take a long rest you canchange one of those masteries to a different mastery on the same list.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Elemental Adept
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Chosen Element**: When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.
**Elemental Affinity**: You gain immunity to the chosen damage type and you can change any damage you deal with spells to the chosen damage type.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different element each time for Chosen Element.

name: Counterstriker
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following beneifits:

entries: **Patient**: You can set two triggers when you hold your action or bonus action.
**Counter Damage**: If you reduce damage using an instaneous reaction, reduce by twice as much.

description.value: This feat is replaced by the Chemical Adept feat

name: War Caster
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, Charisma or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits

entries: **Damage Reduction**: When you take damage from a weapon attack you can reduce the damage by an amount equal to the level of a spell you're concentrating on. If you do, you cannot do so again until the start of your next turn.

**Opportunity Spell**: When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you can use your Reaction to cast a Spell at the creature, rather than making an Opportunity Attack. The Spell must have a casting time of one Action and must target only that creature.

name: Mad Mage
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits

entries: **Spread Madness**: Whenever you fail a saving throw to maintain concentration, enemies within 5 ft of your must succeed on a constitution saving throw or take psychic damage equal to the level of the spell you're concentrating on plus your proficiency bonus.

**Mad Magecraft**: Choose a number of spells you know equal to your proficiency bonus. For each of those spells, choose a damage type. Whenever you cast one of those spells, you can change its damage type to the chosen damage type. You can change one of the spells you chose (and its corresponding damage type) whenever you gain a level in the class that granted you this feat.

name: Great Sage
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, Charisma or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Your mind is fully attuned with your magic, granting you the following benefits:

entries: **Deep Concentration**: Before you take damage you can choose to add your proficiency bonus to a saving throw to maintain concentration that you make as a result of that damage. If you do and fail, you cannot use this again until you finish a short rest.

**Vast Memory**: Learn a number of level 1+ spells equal to your proficiency bonus. They must be spells you can already learn from your spellcasting features. You can replace one of the spells with a different one whenever you level up.
**Large**: Your are one size larger and the weight of your body is multiplied by 4.
**Small**: You are one size smaller and the weight of your body is divided by 4
**Dart**: Once when you take the dash action you can increase your movement speed by 10 ft until the start of your next turn. You regain this ability at the start of your next turn.
**Crowded**: You can occupy the space of other creatures (no more than one at a time).

description.value: You are adept at crafting things and bargaining with merchants, granting you the following benefits:

entries: **Tool Proficiency**: You gain proficiency in an Artisan's Tool of your choice.
**Slapdash**: When you make or help with a crafting check you can divide the time spent modifier by 2. If you do, you cannot do so again until after a short rest.
**Recycle**: When you fail a crafting check there is a 10% chance that your materials are not negatively affected.

description.value: You grant the following benefits

entries: **Instrument Training**: You gain proficiency in a Musical Instrument of your choice.

**Inspiring Song**: As you finish a Long Rest or short rest, you can play a song on a Musical Instrument with which you have Tool Proficiency and give Inspiration to allies who hear the song and do not have any inspiration. The number of allies you can affect in this way equals your Proficiency Bonus.

description.value: Once when you would miss a ranged weapon attack roll you can add two to your attack roll. You regain this ability at the start of your next turn.
When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to the weapon's damage die.

You can use a shield as a d6 bludgeoning weapon with the guard property. If you have training with the shield then you're proficient in it as a weapon. This does not allow you to draw or stow the shield when you would normally draw or stow a weapon. Gain a weapon mastery from any class that can be used with this weapon.

When you would draw or stow a weapon you can instead add or remove the following effect from one of your hands: Weapons in this hand are treated as if they are being held by two hands. You cannot have this effect on both of your hands at the same time unless you take this fighting style again.

Once you can use the reaction of your shield without expending your reaction. It must be a reaction you haven't used this turn and you cannot use this reaction again this turn. You regain this ability after a long rest.
Bonuses to AC granted by shields you are holding also apply to dexterity saving throws.You can use the reaction of a shield when someone you can touch would fail a dexterity saving throw.

You learn one maneuver of your choice from the fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice.)

You gain two Stratagem dice, which are d6 (this die is added to any Stratagem dice you have from another source). This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A Superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended Superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

The weapon damage die of your unarmed strikes is a d6. When you make an unarmed strike, you can choose to make it with two of your free hands. If you do, it counts as a two handed attack and the weapon damage die is a d8.
At the start of each of your turns, you can deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage to one creature you're grappling or holding onto.

You can use strength instead of dexterity for weapons that don't have the loading property. If you do, masteries still treat your attack rolls as dexterity attack rolls. Add 1 to your weapon damage die when you make an attack in this way.
You can give a melee weapon the thrown property when you attack with it. Its range is 60/120 and you subtract 1 from its damage die if you throw it.
You can use dexterity for strength based weapons. Add 1 to your weapon damage die when you make an attack in this way.
Gain a swim speed and a climb speed equal to your movement speed. Increase your movement speed by 5 ft.
You have +1 ac while you are wearing medium or composite armor.
You have +2 to dexterity saving throws while you are wearing light armor or no armor
While you are wearing heavy armor you have tolerance to slashing and piercing damage. Additionally, your max jump distance is not halved.
Add 30 ft to the close range of your thrown weapons (60 instead if it's also a ranged weapon). The long range becomes twice your close range (4 times instead if its also a ranged weapon).
Once per turn when you hit with an attack roll using a light weapon you can add 4 to the weapons damage die.
When you would draw or stow a weapon you can instead apply or unapply the following effect to one of your hands: Weapons in this hand are treated as if they have the light property.

When you gain this fighting style, you choose whether you gain the following feature: You can only have the previous effect on one hand at a time. When you make an attack with a light weapon add 1 to the damage die.

name: Patient Disciple
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Clash**: If you make an attack roll with a versatile weapon against a target immediately when it would hit with an attack roll or would be hit by an attack roll, you can choose to clash. If your attack roll is higher than the opposing attack roll, then the opposing attack misses. Additionally, you can choose to make your attack miss the target.
**Patience**: If you spend your reaction to use a held action, regain your expended reaction.

name: Tool Specialist
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Tools**: Gain proficiency in two tools.
**Ease of Use**: You can make an ability check with one of these tools without holding it as long as it is on your person.
**Masteries**: Gain 2 masteries. Whenever you gain a level you can swap one of these masteries with a different mastery.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Tool Mage
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom, Charisma or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Tools**: Gain proficiency in two tools that are not alliances.
**Mechanical Focus**: You can use those tools as spell focuses.

**Two Cantrips**: Learn two cantrips from a class of your choice. Your spellcasting ability for these cantrips is the spellcasting ability of that class. You can replace these cantrips whenever you gain a level.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Opportunity Flurry
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Extra Opportunity Attack**: You can attack twice, instead of once, when you make an opportunity attack.

name: Spellshield
prerequisite: Level 4, Spellcasting Feature and Armor Training in Shields
abilityIncrease: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Somatic Components**: You can perform the Somatic Components of a spell with a hand that is holding a shield.

**Protect Concentration**: If you receive a bonus to your AC from your shield or cover against an effect and that effect causes you to make a saving throw to maintain concentration, add those AC bonuses to the saving throw.

name: Dual Shielder
prerequisite: Level 4 and Armor Training in Shields
abilityIncrease: Increase your Constitution or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following features.

entries: **Twin Shield**: You can benefit from up to two shields at the same time.
**Weaponized Defenses**: While wielding a shield, you can use 1d6 as the damage die for your unarmed strikes and your opportunity attacks can be unarmed strikes even if you don't have an empty hand.
**Dual Don**: You can don or doff two shields when you normally would don or doff one.

name: Eldritch Adept
abilityIncrease: Increase your Charisma, Wisdom or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following features.

entries: **Invocation**: You learn one Eldritch Invocation option of your choice from the warlock class. Your spellcasting ability for any spells granted by this invocation is the ability you increased with this feat. If the invocation has a prerequisite of any kind, you can choose that invocation only if you meet the prerequisite. If the prerequisite states that you must be atleast a level 2 warlock, ignore that requirement. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace the invocation with another one from the warlock class.

name: Guardian
prerequisite: Level 4 and Armor Training in Shields
abilityIncrease: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Impenetrable**: When you use a reaction granted by a shield you can regain your expended reaction. If you do, you cannot do so again until the start of your next turn. It must be a reaction you haven't used this turn and you cannot use it again this turn.
**Swap**: When you would normally draw or stow a weapon, you can instead swap (stow then draw) one shield you're holding with another shield on your person.

name: Windwalker
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Windstep**: Once you can jump without a surface to push off of as long as you are held aloft or have a reduced fall speed. You regain this ability at the start of your next turn.
**Feather Fall**: You know the Feather Fall spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain this ability after a short rest.
**Launch**: As a reaction to getting pushed or pulled you can double the distance that it pushes or pulls you.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Aviator
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: You gain the following benefits:

**Propel**: As a bonus action you can double your Fly, Glide or Hover speed until the end of your next turn. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.
**Crash Landing**: Once as a reaction before you take damage from falling you can reduce the damage by a number of d6s equal to half your level. You regain this ability after a short rest.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Mind Over Matter
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Ignore Pain**: Choose one of the following:
Whenever you would make a constitution saving throw to maintain concentration, make a wisdom saving throw instead.
Use wisdom instead of constitution for maximum hit points and rolling hit dice.

**Ignore Death**: Once as a bonus action you can ignore all of the negative effects of having zero or less hit points (including death saving throws) for 5 rounds which conclude at the start of your turn. Rounds where you do not spend any movement do not count towards the duration of the effect. You regain this ability after a long rest.
**Repeatable**: You can take this one additional time, but if you do you must pick the other option for ignore pain.

name: Lifesaver
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Emergency Attention**: Immediately before you take the help action to attempt to stabilize a creature you can halve the creature's negative hit points (The hit points must be less than zero). You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses on a long rest.

**Miraculous Recovery**: For every healing die that rolls the highest number it can roll, add a die of that type. This only applies when you are healed or when you heal a creature other than you (choose when you gain this feat).

name: Hazard Training
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Hazardous Distraction**: As a reaction immediately before a creature you can see within a distance equal to a third of your movement speed is affected by a harmful area of effect you can move up to a third of your movement speed straight towards them. If you end your movement in the area of effect, you can make an opportunity attack with a melee weapon against them.

**Avoid Hazard**: When you take the dodge action you can gain immunity to a damage type of your choice until the end of your next turn. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

name: Elusive
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Run Away**: When you use the Take Cover reaction you can move three times as far and until the end of the turn you can apply the bonus granted to you by cover to any saving throw you make.

**Keep Safe**: When you take the dodge action until the end of your next turn creatures other than you that you can touch have advantage on dexterity saving throws and attack rolls against them have disadvantage.

name: Chemical Adept
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Chosen Chemicals**: Choose Poison damage or Acid damage.

**Adjust for Species**: Once at any time you can pick a creature type. Until the start of your next turn, damage you deal of the chosen type to creatures of the type you picked ignores resistance and immunity. Additionally, if any of the damage dice roll their highest value add an additional damage die. It is the same damage type and die type. Additional dice can be added in this way no more than a number of times equal to twice the ability modifier increased by this feat to each instance of damage. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses on a long rest.

name: Tool Expert
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Proficiency**: You gain proficiency in one tool of your choice.
**Expertise**: Gain expertise in a tool offered by the class that granted you this feat. If you were proficient in that tool, gain proficiency in a tool of your choice.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Storied Past
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **1st-level feat**: Gain a first level feat.

name: Dirty Fighting
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Concealed Weapon**: Attacking with a light weapon does not reveal you from hiding.

**Bleed**: Once when you hit with a light weapon you can make the target bleed. If you do, they take damage equal to your proficiency bonus at the end of each of their turns until they use their action to stop it. You regain this ability after a short rest.
**Repeatable**: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Demolitionist
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity, Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: **Toss**: When you take the attack action you can spend one of its attacks to use a consumable that would normally take an action to use. If you do, you cannot do so again until the start of your next turn. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

**Fuse**: As an action you can attach a consumable to a surface. Choose a number of rounds up to a minute, concluding at the end of your turn. It must be a consumable that takes an action to use. When someone steps on the 5ft square of surface it's attached to or the fuse's duration has passed, the item is used. The effect is centered on the space adjacent to the surface it was attached to.
**At the ready**: You can draw or stow a consumable that takes an action to use when you would normally draw or stow a weapon.

description.value: You possess a Lesser Dragonmark, which is visible somewhere on your body. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Manifest Dragonmark
description.value: You manifest a dragonmark. Your choice of Mark is restricted by your species, as shown in the Least Dragonmark Benefit table. Your choice of Mark determines the skills, tools, and spells you gain, as given in the same table. When you select this feat, choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as your spellcasting ability for the feat's cantrip(s) and spells.

description.name: Guidance of the Mark
description.value: You add 1d4 to any ability check you make using the skills or tools associated with your Mark.

description.name: Cantrip
description.value: You learn the cantrip(s) associated with your Mark. The Mark of Handling and Mark of Warding don't grant a cantrip; instead, each Mark grants three Spells of the Mark.

description.name: Spells of the Mark
description.value: Your dragonmark grants you access to the spells associated with your Mark. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each of them once at their lowest level without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't cast them in this way again until you finish a Long Rest. To cast any of these spells at a higher level or a second time prior to finishing a Long Rest, you must expend a spell slot.

table.title: Lesser Dragonmark Benefit
rows: Detect Poison and Disease, See Invisibility
Locate Animals and Plants, Locate Object
Animal Friendship, Beast Sense, Speak with Animals
Persuasion, Brewer's Supplies or Cook's Utensils
Calm Emotions, Purify Food and Drink
Comprehend Languages, Illusory Script (no Material component required)

description.value: You have learned a certain number of the secrets and techniques of the Ashbound druidic order. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Ability Score Increase
description.value: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.name: Ashbound Proficiencies
description.value: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

description.name: Arcane Enmity
description.value: When a creature you can see casts a spell, you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn.

description.name: Ashbound Spells
description.value: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Ashbound Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

name: Gatekeeper Initiate
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have learned a certain number of secrets and techniques of the Gatekeeper druidic order. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Ability Score Increase
description.value: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.name: Gatekeeper Proficiency
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Arcana* skill.

description.name: Protection Against Aberrations
description.value: When you make a saving throw against the magic abilities of an Aberration or a spell cast by an Aberration, you can roll 1d4 and add it to your saving throw.

description.name: Gatekeeper Spells
description.value: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Gatekeeper Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

name: Greensinger Initiate
abilityIncrease: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have learned a certain number of secrets and techniques of the Greensinger druidic order. You gain the following benefits:

description.name: Ability Score Increase
description.value: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.name: Greensinger's Proficiency
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Performance* skill.

description.name: Fey Dancer
description.value: Whenever you cause a creature to gain the Charmed condition, you can join them in dance and revelry. If you do so, you can use your Reaction to move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

description.name: Fey Affinity
description.value: Your spells and magical abilities that affect Humanoids also affect Fey

description.name: Greensinger Spells
description.value: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Greensinger Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

name: Hewn for Battle
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have reshaped your stone body to be a more effective and devastating weapon of war. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Ability Score Increase
description.value: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.name: Thickened Hide
description.value: When you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can choose the thickness of your natural armor. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class becomes your choice of either 14 plus your Dexterity modifier, or 18. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

description.name: Spellcarving
description.value: Your hide can be enchanted or infused as if it were nonmagical armor.

description.name: Claws
description.value: You have shaped your hands into fearsome claws. Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make Unarmed Strikes. If you hit with them, you deal Slashing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier in place of the normal Bludgeoning damage of your Unarmed Strike.
Your skill with magical Orbs helps you evade enemies while overcoming their defenses. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Fortune Teller
description.value: When you finish a Short or Long Rest, roll 1d6 and record the result. When you cast a spell using an Orb as a Spellcasting Focus, you can add the result of this prescience roll to your spell attack roll, or reduce one target's saving throw by that amount. You must choose to do so before the attack roll or saving throw.
Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Unused prescience rolls are lost when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: See the Path
description.value: While you are holding an Orb, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

description.name: Prescient Escape
description.value: While you are holding an Orb, whenever a creature you can see enters a space within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to move up to your Speed without provoking an Opportunity Attack.
You've mastered the use of a rod as an Arcane Focus. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Close-Ranged Focus
description.value: If the target of a cantrip you cast using a Rod as a Spellcasting Focus is within 20 feet of you when you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

description.name: Unshakeable Casting
description.value: When you make a ranged spell attack roll while using a Rod as a Spellcasting Focus, you do not have Disadvantage on the roll if you are within 5 feet of an enemy.

description.name: Rough & Tumble

description.name: Powerful Focus

description.name: Explosive Casting
description.value: If all targets of a spell you cast using a Staff as your Spellcasting Focus are more than half the spell's range from you, one creature of your choice that you hit with a spell attack or that fails a saving throw against the spell has the Prone condition.

Your Petrifying Gaze has come into its own. If a creature that has the Restrained or Paralyzed condition as a result of one of your spells or your Medusa's Gift trait fails a saving throw to end the effect by 5 or more, you can choose to turn that creature to stone. Any magical effects causing the creature to have the Restrained or Paralyzed condition end, and the creature has the Petrified condition for 1 minute. You must concentrate to maintain the effect. If you lose your Concentration, the Petrified condition ends.
If you maintain your Concentration on the effect for the entire possible duration, the target is Petrified until the condition is ended by __Greater Restoration__ or similar magic.
