You were somehow mutated or created by an aberration, such as a god-aboleth, and you suffer from strange deformities as a result. Due to these changes, you gain the following benefits.

description.name: Aberrant Mind
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition on yourself and against any effect that would read your thoughts.

description.name: Psychic Resistance
description.value: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

description.name: Tentacle
description.value: At least one of your limbs is muscular, rubbery, and pliant, akin to a tentacle that you can use to make Unarmed Strikes. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes. Additionally, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC. When you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, you deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier instead of the strike's normal damage.

You are an escaped android—likely a Version 13—that is functionally a perfect replica of a human being, except that wires and blinking lights lie hidden underneath your skin. It is even possible you aren't aware of your construct origins, owing to faulty programming, willing suppression of memory, or intentional tampering with your construct core. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Construct Anatomy
description.value: You don't need food, drink, or air. You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

description.name: Machine Code
description.value: You know Machine Code (DarkMatter24), the native code-language of machines. Due to this language, you know the __Technomancy__ cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you install the graft).

description.name: Technical Expertise
description.value: You gain proficiency in your choice of *Data*, *Piloting*, or *Technology*.

Your world is nearly one continuous ocean, with nary an island in sight. Consequently, you have aquatic features, like gills, webbed fingers and toes, and fishlike scales, that grant you the following benefits.

description.name: Aquatic
description.value: You can breathe underwater.

description.name: Finned
description.value: You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

description.name: Marine Speech
description.value: You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast, Elemental, or Monstrosity that has a Swim Speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

The 'Verse is rife with wolf-people, horse-people, and other beastfolk, ranging from those with passing bestial features—such as a cat's ears and tail—to those that are indistinguishable from a lycanthrope. You may resemble any type of beast, but always gain the following benefits.

description.name: Animalistic Reflexes
description.value: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws if you are *Bloodied*.

description.name: Claws
description.value: You have sharp claws that you can use to make Unarmed Strikes. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes. When you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal Slashing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier instead of the strike's normal damage.
Your people metabolize by basking in the sunlight, aided by your tough, photosynthetic skin, which grants you the following benefits.

description.name: Natural Armor
description.value: Your skin acts as a tough natural armor. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 13 plus your Dexterity modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

description.name: Photosynthetic Resilience
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

description.name: Poison Resistance
description.value: You have Resistance to Poison damage.

One of your parents was a creature of darkness, such as a shadow or a native to the Plane of Shadow. Grues such as yourself have blackened skin and cast a shadow in all directions, even when directly in light. In shadows, you are nearly invisible. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Covert
description.value: When you are hidden and a creature discovers you with a successful Wisdom (*Perception*) check, you can take the Hide action as a Reaction to quickly conceal yourself. If your Dexterity (*Stealth*) roll beats the creature's Wisdom (*Perception*) check, you silently reposition yourself and the creature doesn't notice you. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: Darkvision
description.value: You have __Darkvision__ with a range of 120 feet.

description.name: Swirl of Shadows
description.value: When you reach character level 5, you can cloak yourself in perfect darkness. You can cast the __Invisibility__ spell on yourself without a spell slot while you are entirely within Dim Light or Darkness. The spell ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition or you end your turn in Bright Light. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Insectoids bear one or two insectlike features, such as prominent compound eyes or chitinous plates, but almost always have a pair of sensitive antennae atop their heads. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Blindsight
description.value: Due to your antennae, you have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

description.name: Regenerative
description.value: If any part of your body is amputated, but its amputation doesn't kill you, that body part fully regrows over the course of 24 hours.

You are a porterling, parented both by a human and one of the little folk, either a gnome or a halfling. You stand about as tall as a dwarf, but are far leaner—and if fathered by a gnome, are also somewhat top-heavy. Though they are often confused for dwarves, porterlings can't grow large or thick beards. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Flexible
description.value: You have Advantage on checks you make to end the Grappled condition or to escape from nonmagical restraints.

description.name: Nimbleness
description.value: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

description.name: Springheel Leap
description.value: Whenever you make a High or Long jump, you can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when making a standing jump. As normal, each foot you jump costs a foot of movement.
You come from a world of ancient fauna and colossal flora. Your people are hardy and robust, much like early humans. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Brave
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

description.name: Primal Toughness
description.value: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

Most humans possess some dull psionic potential, but those that unlock their psionic spark transcend their peers. Sometimes, these humans are indistinguishable from ordinary folks, but other times their psionic awakening leaves a tell-tale mark: stark white hair, glowing pupils, or hair and clothing that float and drift around them. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Empathy
description.value: You can take the Magic action to probe the mind of a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's emotional state.

description.name: Psionics
description.value: You learn the __Mage Hand__ cantrip. You can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, you can make the spectral hand Invisible, and its range increases by 30 feet when you cast it.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the __Unseen Servant__ spell, and when you reach character level 5, you learn the __Levitate__ spell. You always have these spells prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast the spell in that way again when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast either spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose the ability when you select this species).
You bear the abrasive skin, slitted eyes, and forked tongue of a reptile, which grant you the following benefits.

description.name: Acid Spit
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with a lob of acid from your mouth. This is a special ranged attack with a range of 60 feet. You are proficient with it, and you add your Dexterity modifier to its attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Acid damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).
You can use this Acid Spit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Reptilian Resistance
description.value: You have Resistance to Acid, Fire, or Poison damage (choose when you select this species).
You hail from an icy, desolate world, thrown away from its home star by some catastrophic event. Surviving the interminable harshness of your home gives you the following benefits.

description.name: Darkvision
description.value: You have __Darkvision__ with a range of 60 feet.

description.name: Cold Resistance
description.value: You have Resistance to Cold damage.

description.name: Extremophile
description.value: You take no damage from cold Extreme Temperatures (see Glossary). Extremely hot conditions affect you normally.

You hail from a world that followed a slightly different evolutionary path to High Terra; your people all resemble monkeys or apes. Despite your furry appearance and prominent tail, you are just as intelligent as other humans—you just like bananas a little more. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Climbing Speed
description.value: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

description.name: Prehensile Tail
description.value: You can hold and manipulate objects and weapons with your hands, feet, and tail, but you can't make attacks with weapons held by your tail.

description.name: Soft Landing
description.value: You can take a Reaction when you fall to reduce any damage you take from the fall by an amount equal to five times your Proficiency Bonus.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Heirloom
description.value: You gain an Uncommon magic item of the GM's choice, passed down through generations of your family. A Bag of Holding or Cloak of Protection is recommended.

description.name: Stipend
description.value: You gain 100 CR and gain another 100 CR whenever you gain a character level thereafter.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Innovation
description.value: Whenever you roll a 20 on the d20 for an ability check, you gain Heroic Inspiration. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: Double Inspiration
description.value: You can have two instances of Heroic Inspiration at one time. You can use only one Heroic Inspiration per roll.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Gaming Sets
description.value: You gain proficiency with all Gaming Sets and have Advantage on ability checks you make for games of chance.

description.name: Losing Streak
description.value: Record whenever you roll a 9 or lower on the d20 for a D20 Test. Roll the d20s for Advantage and Disadvantage sequentially and record them in order. If you roll 9 or lower three or more times consecutively, you can immediately change the d20 roll to a 20. If this was an attack roll, it doesn't score a Critical Hit. Once you use this feat to change a d20 roll, discard your recorded rolls.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Hardworking
description.value: Choose one skill with which you have proficiency. When you gain a level, you replace the skill you chose with a different one.

Whenever you fail an ability check using  that skill, you can roll a d6 and add it to the roll, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Strong Core
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid the Exhaustion condition.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Mutual Misery
description.value: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for a D20 Test, choose a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target has Disadvantage on the next D20 Test it makes within the next minute.

description.name: Unlucky Number
description.value: Whenever an enemy rolls a 13 on the d20 for an attack against you or on a saving throw against a spell that you cast, the d20 roll becomes a 1.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Argumentative
description.value: You can use your choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for Persuasion checks.

description.name: Diplomatic
description.value: When you take the Influence action, you can treat a Hostile creature as Indifferent, and an Indifferent creature as Friendly.

description.name: Polyglot
description.value: You learn three languages of your choice.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Cantrip Device
description.value: You build a device that allows you to cast cantrip of your choice from the Wizard spell list that doesn't deal damage (choose when you build this device). When you finish a Long Rest, you can build a new device and choose a different cantrip for it, causing the old one to become inactive.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the cantrip you cast with this device (choose the ability when you select the feat).

description.name: Mind Over Matter
description.value: Choose one skill. When you make an ability check using that skill, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead of the normal ability score for that skill. When you gain a level, you replace the skill you chose with a different one.

name: Blaster Master
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.name: Blaster Roulette
description.value: If you roll the same number of two damage dice for a blaster, you deal bonus damage equal to that number. You can only add this bonus damage once per turn.

description.name: Ignore Cooldown
description.value: You ignore the Cooldown property of weapons.

description.name: Run and Gun
description.value: When you take the Dash or Disengage action, you can make a ranged attack using a blaster as a Bonus Action.

name: Brutal Grip
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.name: Heavy Duelist
description.value: You can wield a Melee weapon with Two-Handed in one hand.

description.name: Versatile Dual Wielder
description.value: While wielding a Melee weapon with Versatile in one hand, the weapon has the Light property for you.

name: Chronomancy Initiate
prerequisite: Level 4+ and Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Cantrip
description.value: You learn the __Moment to Think__ cantrip.

description.name: Expanded Spell List
description.value: Spells with the [Chronomancy] tag are added to your spell list.
The spells __Haste__, __Slow__, and __Time Stop__ have the [Chronomancy] tag.

description.name: Prepared Spells
description.value: Choose a number of spells with the [Chronomancy] tag equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell with the [Chronomancy] tag.

name: Demolitionist
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Grenade
description.value: When you finish a Long Rest, you can make one Concussion Grenade, Flashbang, or Freeze Bomb. This item lasts until you finish another Long Rest, at which point it harmlessly falls apart.

description.name: Improved Ordinance
description.value: Your Bombs, Bottled Lightning, Concussion Grenades, Flashbangs, and Freeze Bombs use the following DC if it is higher: 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus.

description.name: Quick Grenade
description.value: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Concussion Grenade, Flashbang, or Freeze Bomb.

name: Factotum
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the Ability Score Increase benefit and one of the following options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with a different one. You can use the chosen option a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Flurry of Blows
description.value: You can make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.

description.name: Reckless Attack
description.value: When you make your first attack roll on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you Advantage on attack rolls using Strength until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage during that time.

description.name: Second Wind
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus half your character level.

description.name: Sneak Attack
description.value: Once per turn, you can deal an extra **1d6** damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon. The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type. You don't need Advantage on the attack roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, and you don't have Disadvantage on the attack roll. The extra damage increases by 1d6 when you reach character level 7 (2d6), 11 (3d6), 15 (4d6), and 19 (5d6).

name: Field Commander
abilityIncrease: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Command
description.value: As an action, you can issue a command to an ally within 60 feet that can hear you. It can immediately take an action as a Reaction. That action can be used to take only the Attack (one attack only), Dash, Dodge, Hide, Influence, Search, Study, or Utilize action. When a creature takes the Dash action in this way, the benefits of that action last until the end of the creature's next turn.

description.name: Tight Formation
description.value: While you are within 5 feet of two or more allies that don't have the Incapacitated condition, enemies can't have Advantage on attack rolls against you.

name: Flex Caster
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Upcast
description.value: When you cast a spell, such as __Magic Missile__, that can be cast with a higher-level spell slot, you can expend an additional spell slot to increase the spell's effective level by 1.

description.name: Downcast
description.value: When you cast a spell using a higher-level spell slot, you choose to recycle the excess magical energy instead of improving the spell. The spell is cast at its base level and you regain an expended level 1 spell slot.

name: Focused Critical
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Improved Critical
description.value: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

name: Grafter
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Embedded Weapons
description.value: You can embed a Simple or Martial weapon directly into your body, or you can embed two weapons (one into each arm) if neither has Two-Handed. Embedded weapons take up the Arms graft slot. When you draw an embedded weapon, it snaps to your hand and you can't be disarmed of it. You can switch which weapons are embedded when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Extra Slots
description.value: You have two Arm graft slots and two Internal graft slots. You can install a graft in each of them.

description.name: Quick Installation
description.value: You can take the Utilize action to install a Construct graft on your body.

description.name: Painless Attachment
description.value: You don't lose Hit Point Dice from installing or removing grafts, and it takes you no time to recover after the attachment of a new graft.

name: Gun-Mage Adept
prerequisite: Level 4+ and Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Ranged Weapon Proficiency
description.value: You gain proficiency with Ranged Martial weapons.

description.name: Cantrip
description.value: You learn the __Finger Guns__ cantrip.

description.name: Expanded Spell List
description.value: The following spells are added to your spell list: __Antiballistics Field__, __Ballistic Smite__, __Conjure Cannonball__, __Conjure Cover__, __Jam Weapon__, __Jethro's Instant Reload__, and __Perforating Shot__.

description.name: Spells Prepared
description.value: Choose a number of spells equal to your Proficiency Bonus from among those in the Expanded Spell List benefit. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell from the Expanded Spell List.

name: Hacker
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Black Hat
description.value: You are always treated as having an Interface Rig. Furthermore, devices never lock after your attempts to hack them.

description.name: Data Expert
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Data* skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain Expertise in it.

description.name: Quick Hack
description.value: You can attempt to hack a device as a Utilize action, rather than over the course of one minute.

description.name: Ranged Hack
description.value: You can make Hacking attempts on Magical Technology you can see within 60 feet of yourself.

name: Iron Hero
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Underdog's Resolve
description.value: When you are attacked by a creature that has a CR higher than your level, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class for that attack.

description.name: Vengeful Strike
description.value: You have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has reduced one of your allies to 0 Hit Points since the end of your last turn.

description.name: Heroic Intervention
description.value: When an enemy you can see takes a Legendary Action, you can take a Reaction to intercede, preventing the Legendary Action from happening. You can take this Reaction a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Laser Swordsmaster
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Cauterizing Critical
description.value: When you score a Critical Hit with an Antimatter Dagger, Laser Claws, Laser Sword, or Laser Greatsword, you can rake the target with the blade. Instead of rolling the attack's damage dice twice, you add the attack's maximum damage to the roll.

description.name: Deflect Blaster
description.value: If you're holding an Antimatter Dagger, Laser Claws, Laser Sword, or Laser Greatsword, and another creature hits you with a ranged attack using a blaster, you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armor Class for this attack. If this causes the attack to miss, you can deflect the blaster bolt toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus) or take damage as if hit by the triggering attack.

name: Magitechnician
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Magic Item Expert
description.value: If one of your magic items calls for a saving throw, it uses the following DC if it is higher: 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus.

description.name: Magic Item Recharge
description.value: When you finish a Short Rest, you can recharge a magic item that has charges or properties that recharge at the next dawn. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Marksman's Luck
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Flip Die
description.value: Once per turn, when you roll for damage with a Ranged weapon, you can flip one of the damage dice over and use the number on the bottom. You can't use this ability on d4s. Note that for a balanced die, the top and bottom numbers add up to one more than the die's largest number.

description.name: Enhanced Critical
description.value: When you score a Critical Hit with a Ranged weapon, the target's Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.

name: Mechanic
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Burn Out
description.value: You can use the __Overheat__ mastery property on any blaster even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use. When you use this property with this feat, the extra damage equals twice your Proficiency Bonus and the weapon remains Overheated until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: Technology Expert
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Technology* skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain Expertise in it.

description.name: Vent Tape Repairs
description.value: You can cast the __Mending__ cantrip while holding Vent Tape. By expending an entire roll of Vent Tape, you can cast the __Greater Mending__ spell once without a spell slot. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells. Once you cast __Greater Mending__ in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Merc
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Blaster Melee
description.value: When you attack with a blaster, you can replace its mastery property with the __Bludgeon__ property for that attack. You can use the __Bludgeon__ mastery property of the blaster, even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use.

description.name: Point Blank
description.value: When you hit a creature within 10 feet of you with a ranged attack roll using a weapon that has the Heavy or Two-Handed properties, the target takes extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon.

description.name: Tactical Signals
description.value: You learn Common Sign Language (XPHB). You can communicate tactical messages of 10 words or fewer with a creature that can see the message. The creature doesn't need to share a language with you to understand this message, but it must be able to understand at least one language.

You feel impressions of events an instant before they happen. When you start your turn, you can roll a d20 and record the number rolled. You can replace any D20 Test made by you or a creature that you can see before the start of your next turn with this roll.
You can use this feat a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Pyromaniac
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Firestarter Magic
description.value: You know the __Fire Bolt__ cantrip and you always have the __Burning Hands__ and __Scorching Ray__ spells prepared. You can cast __Burning Hands__ and __Scorching Ray__ without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is the ability increased by this feat.

description.name: Flare Damage
description.value: Whenever you deal Fire damage and roll the highest number on any damage die, you can roll that damage die again and add it to the damage, rolling again if it is the highest number, and so on. You can add a maximum number of dice to the damage roll equal to your Proficiency Bonus (minimum of 1).

name: Shock Trooper
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: First Strike
description.value: You have Advantage attack rolls you make with Melee weapons and Unarmed Strikes during the first round of combat.

description.name: Rapid Advance
description.value: On the first round of combat, your Speed is doubled and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement.

name: Showman
abilityIncrease: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Expert Performer
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Performance* skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain Expertise in it.

description.name: Taunt
description.value: You can take a Bonus Action to mock a creature within 15 feet of you. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against a creature other than you before the end of its next turn.
You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Smuggler
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Expert Pilot
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Piloting* skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain Expertise in it.

description.name: Inconspicuous Cargo
description.value: You have Advantage on ability checks you make to hide, move, sell, and lie about cargo.

description.name: Shoot First
description.value: When you roll Initiative and don't have Disadvantage, you can draw a blaster and make a ranged attack using it.
You can use your Biomimicry trait over the course of 1 minute to perfectly alter your appearance.

You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same.
You were born aligned with shadows, instead of the sun, granting you the following benefits.

description.name: Covert
description.value: When you are hidden and a creature discovers you with a successful Wisdom (*Perception*) check, you can take the Hide action as a Reaction to quickly conceal yourself. If your Dexterity (*Stealth*) roll beats the creature's Wisdom (*Perception*) check, you silently reposition yourself and the creature doesn't notice you. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: Craven
description.value: When an enemy you can see misses you with a Melee attack, you can take a Reaction to move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

description.name: Stealthy
description.value: You have proficiency in the *Stealth* skill.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Dual Ancestry
description.value: Choose a second Draconic Ancestry option. The color of your scales reflect both of your dragon ancestors. You have Resistance to the damage type associated with both ancestries, and can use either damage type for your Breath Weapon.

description.name: Improved Breath Weapon
description.value: Your Breath Weapon deals an extra **1d10** damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

description.name: Adamantine Skin
description.value: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

description.name: Adamantine Bones
description.value: Any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Barkflesh
description.value: While you aren't wearing any armor, your Armor Class equals 15. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

description.name: Natural Regeneration
description.value: As a Magic action, you can heal your ironwood flesh. Expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll the die, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

You know the __Technomancy__ cantrip. When you reach character level 3, you learn the __Technical Difficulties__ spell, and when you reach character level 5, you learn the __Circuit Breaker__ spell. You always have these spells prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast the spell in that way again when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast either spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this feat (choose the ability when you select this feat).

When you finish a Long Rest, you gain proficiency in a weapon, skill, or tool of your choice, or you temporarily learn a cantrip from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's cantrip (choose when you select this feat). You retain this proficiency or cantrip until you finish a Long Rest.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Integrated Weapons
description.value: You can integrate a weapon directly into your Aqua Suit, or you can integrate two weapons (one into each arm) if neither has Two-Handed. When you draw an integrated weapon, it snaps to your hand and you can't be disarmed of it. You can switch which weapons are integrated when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Sonar
description.value: While wearing your Aqua Suit, you have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. The range increases to 30 feet if you are underwater.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Adrenaline Rush
description.value: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: Relentless Endurance
description.value: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Armored Exoskeleton
description.value: While you have all of your Hit Points, you have a +2 bonus to AC.

description.name: Eat Anything
description.value: Any organic matter that you eat provides nourishment. Inorganic matter doesn't provide nourishment, but you can eat anything softer than stone without negative effects.

description.name: Molt
description.value: You can shed your exoskeleton as a Bonus Action, allowing you to remove one or more of the following conditions from yourself: Blinded, Deafened, Grappled, Poisoned, Prone, or Restrained. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your birth was corrupted by the Foulest Abyss of mechademons, granting you the following benefits.

description.name: Cyber Claw
description.value: Your fingers bear retractable metal claws. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes. When you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal Necrotic damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier instead of the strike's normal damage.

description.name: Translocator
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can activate glowing circuits underneath your skin to magically teleport 15 feet to a location you can see.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Configuration Upgrade
description.value: When you make an ability check using Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution, you can choose to make it using one of the other two. Alternatively, when you make an ability check using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can choose to make it using one of the other two.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Improved Optics
description.value: You can take a Magic action to swap your Thermalsight for Blindsight with a range of 10 feet or Darkvision with a range of 120 feet. This sense lasts until you use this feature to swap back to Thermalsight or choose a different one.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Empathy
description.value: You can take the Magic action to probe the mind of a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's emotional state.

description.name: Improved Psionic Blast
description.value: Your Psionic Blast deals an extra **1d10** Psychic damage.

description.name: Minor Kinesis
description.value: You learn the __Mage Hand__ cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this benefit. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell when you cast them with this property (choose when you attune to this item).
You come from a unique population of halflings, as diminutive to regular halflings as their kin are to humans. You have the following benefits.

description.name: Tiny
description.value: Your size is Tiny.

description.name: Miniature Weapons
description.value: You can only wield weapons designed for creatures of your size. Generally, such weapons are identical to their standard versions but their damage dice decrease by one step (d12 or 2d6 → d10 → d8 → d6 → d4, to a minimum of d4).

description.name: Nimble
description.value: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.
*Ship Feat*
You have logged thousands of hours at a starship's helm, granting you the following benefits.

description.name: Piloting Expert
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Piloting* skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you have Expertise in it.

description.name: Hard Turn
description.value: When you take the Evasive Maneuvers action, you can move the ship 1,000 feet in any direction.

description.name: Ramming Maneuver
description.value: You have Advantage on attack rolls you make with ship Melee weapons as a part of the Pilot Crew Role.

description.name: Ship Feats
description.value: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

description.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
description.value: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.
*Ship Feat*
Your experience casting spells from a starship's Arcane Cannon grants you the following benefits.

description.name: Mega Cantrip
description.value: When you use the Arcane Cannon action to magnify a cantrip that deals damage to Mega scale, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll.

description.name: Over-Cast
description.value: When you cast a Mega spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can give one target of the spell Disadvantage on saves against the spell. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: Ship Feats
description.value: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

description.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
description.value: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.
*Ship Feat*
As a full-fledged Battleframe Pilot, known as a Dragoon, your combat prowess grants you the following benefits.

description.name: Kaiju Slayer
description.value: Once on each of your turns, you can gain Advantage on an attack roll you make against a Mega creature.

description.name: Relentless Retaliation
description.value: When you are the Pilot of a Battleframe that is reduced to 0 Mega Hit Points, you can drop to 1 Mega Hit Point instead. You can immediately make one melee attack with a frame weapon as a Reaction. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: One Hundred to Oni
description.value: After one hundred recorded kills, you earn the rank of Oni. Record whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points. When you reach 100, you gain the Faction feat __Lakshay: Oni__.

description.name: Ship Feats
description.value: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

description.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
description.value: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.
*Ship Feat*
You are a brilliant engineer, knowledgeable of every system on board your ship, and capable of fixing just about anything. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Technology Expert
description.value: You gain proficiency in the *Technology* skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you have Expertise in it.

description.name: Advanced Repairs
description.value: When you take the Emergency Repairs action, you can choose to make a DC 20 check instead of a DC 15 one. On a success, the ship regains an additional 10 Mega Hit Points.

description.name: Ship Firewall
description.value: While you are in the Engineer role, the Pilot has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws they make on behalf of the ship.

description.name: Ship Feats
description.value: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated.
